audit.whatIsWrong: Body Slam was named as the tracked cooldown but never with a number, and the reason it matters — it is a 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s stun-dash that is also his only escape — was never stated.
audit.why: Riot's E text: Gragas charges to a location, collides with the first enemy unit, damaging and stunning nearby enemies. With it spent he cannot reposition out of your Q yank, which is exactly the window your whole pattern needs.
audit.corrected: Body Slam's 14s rank-1 number and its dual role (stun plus only escape) written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and report[5]; Explosive Cask's 100s added as the level-6 gate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with the packet and with the mirror: Level 1 read Skill, Levels 4-5 read Skill, Level 6 read Skill despite whys[4] saying the window swings to Gragas, and First item read Kled despite whys[5] ending 'call it even'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Kled / Skill / Kled / Kled / Gragas / Skill / Kled and the mirror audit states both charts were flipped to exactly that as one atomic group, so leaving these creates a mirror disagreement as well as a self-contradiction.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 5 flipped in matched full/content pairs to Kled / Skill / Kled / Gragas / Skill, with the level-1 and level-6 whys and phases rewritten so the prose matches the new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer wrote 'Beartrap'; the ability is Bear Trap on a Rope. Drunken Rage's auto-attack reset tell and Barrel Roll's ramping potency were absent, and Explosive Cask's ability to knock you out of your own R charge appeared only in the content layer.
audit.why: Riot's W text: Gragas samples his brew for 1 second, then his next basic attack deals magic damage in an area and he takes reduced damage — the drink, not the hit, is the tell. Riot's Q text: the cask explodes on activation or after 4 seconds and 'the potency of the explosion increases over time'. Kled's R is a dash, so a knockback mid-charge cancels the ram.
audit.corrected: Name fixed, the drink-is-the-tell written into dontsFull[0], the ramping barrel into dontsFull[1], and Explosive Cask's 100s cooldown into the full layer's cooldown block and report[5].

edits.before: You concede Level 1 with no poke, but so does Gragas — keep Skaarl's mount health full and just farm out his Barrel Q chip.
edits.after: Skaarl's mounted stat lead beats a level-1 Gragas with only Barrel Roll chip and 80 mana to spend on it — take the first trade.

edits.before: CHAAAARGE turns any side wave into a cross-map gank. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gragas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Explosive Cask (100s) knocks you out of your own charge or punts you off him mid-combo — level 6 belongs to Gragas.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Body Slam's cooldown.
edits.after: Eclipse burst against his pool sustain — force fights only with Body Slam (14s) spent.

edits.before: Beartrap Gragas when his answer is down, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage and remount mid-fight.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope Gragas once Body Slam is spent, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage.

edits.before: - Gragas Body Slam: matchup-defining — His engage. Q-pull when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gragas Body Slam: matchup-defining — a 14s stun-dash that is also his only escape. All-in the moment it is spent. - Explosive Cask: 100s at rank 1, it punts you out of your charge. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: His engage. Q-pull when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Body Slam is 14s and his only escape — Q-yank and commit once it is spent.

edits.before: That is Gragas's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Drunken Rage's drink is the tell — step back on the sip, not on the slam.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Barrel Roll grows stronger the longer it sits — walk out, then fight.

edits.before: Track Gragas's Body Slam: His engage. Q-pull when it’s down. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Body Slam (14s) stuns and is his only escape; Explosive Cask (100s) punts you out of your R charge.

notes: Both packet defects are FALSE POSITIVES — 'His Explosive Cask' and 'Hit Explosive Cask' are the correct ability name preceded by an ordinary word. Executioner's Calling in report[8] is justified from this side: Happy Hour heals Gragas on every skill cast, so Grievous Wounds does bite the sustain the line describes (the mirror auditor listed this as unverified from Gragas's side, where the same string is about Kled, who has no heal). Body Slam is a stun, not a knockup, so tenacity shortens it but it is not something Kled's Q knockup trades against.
